report.summary: daedalus/structcore/churn.py: Responsible for computing git churn (line change frequency per file) and temporal coupling (co-change pairs) between files, providing health signals for code complexity and hidden dependencies.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/churn.py|git_churn guarantees degradation to {} on any failure.
CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/churn.py|co_change_pairs degrades to [] on any git failure.
CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/churn.py|temporal_misses ensures co-change pairs exclude those with static import edges and documents.
SMELL|daedalus/structcore/churn.py|Deferred import in temporal_misses to avoid circular dependency with index and markdown.
todos: daedalus/structcore/churn.py|module|churn|Provides git churn and temporal coupling analysis.
daedalus/structcore/churn.py|function|git_churn|Returns per-file added+deleted lines from git history, degrades to {} on failure.
daedalus/structcore/churn.py|function|co_change_pairs|Returns list of co-change pairs with PMI and lift, degrades to [] on failure.
daedalus/structcore/churn.py|function|temporal_misses|Filters co-change pairs to those without static import edges, excluding documents.
daedalus/structcore/churn.py|constant|COCHANGE_MAX_FILES_PER_COMMIT|Maximum files per commit for co-change analysis (40).
